mapper.select: select bodi.item_name as itemName, bodi.qty as qty, bodi.farmer_id as farmerId, bodi.sys_item_code as sysItemCode, bodi.item_cd as itemCd, bodi.item_price as itemPrice, bodi.item_price_tax as itemPriceTax, bodi.item_sales_tax as itemSalesTax, bodi.subtotal as subtotal, bodi.subtotal_tax as subtotalTax from bss_order_delivery_item bodi where bodi.order_id = #{orderId} AND bodi.delivery_id = #{deliveryId}

SELECT bo.id, bo.order_id, bo.sys_order_id, bo.farmer_id, bo.status, bo.order_time, bo.delivery_plan_date, bo.payment_type, bo.payment_date, bo.ship_plan_date, bo.ship_date, bo.delivery_date, bo.sys_customer_id, bo.member_id, bo.customer_id, bo.customer_name, bo.postal_code, bo.address, bo.customer_memo, bo.mail_address, bo.phone_number, bo.item_total_tax, bo.item_total, sdd.dict_label as status_label, sdd2.dict_label as proxy_order_ch_label --.dict_label as dlvdelivery_flg_label --bod.delivery_method as dlvdelivery_flg_label FROM bss_order bo INNER JOIN bss_order_extends boe on bo.order_id = boe.order_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data sdd on sdd.dict_value = bo.status and sdd.dict_type = 'bss_order_status' LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data sdd2 on sdd2.dict_value = boe.proxy_order_ch and sdd2.dict_type = 'bss_proxy_order_ch' -- LEFT JOIN bss_order_delivery bod on bod.order_id = bo.order_id and bod.farmer_id = bo.farmer_id -- LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data sdd1 on sdd1.dict_value = bo.dlvdelivery_flg and sdd1.dict_type = 'bss_dlvdelivery_flg'
where bo.order_id = #{orderId} AND bo.farmer_id = #{farmerId}

SELECT bo.order_id as orderId ,bo.order_time as orderTime ,mi.item_id as itemId ,bodi.item_cd as itemCode ,bodi.sys_item_code as sysItemCode ,bodi.item_name as itemName ,bodi.item_price as itemPrice ,mi.jan_code as janCode ,mi.sumareji_item_id as sumarejiItemId -- ,sdd1.dict_label as dlvdelivery ,bod.delivery_method as deliveryMethod FROM bss_order_delivery_item bodi INNER JOIN bss_order bo ON bo.order_id = bodi.order_id INNER JOIN mast_item mi ON mi.sys_item_code = bodi.sys_item_code AND mi.farmer_id = bo.farmer_id LEFT JOIN bss_order_delivery bod on bod.order_id = bo.order_id and bod.farmer_id = bo.farmer_id -- LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data sdd1 on sdd1.dict_value = bo.dlvdelivery_flg and sdd1.dict_type = 'bss_dlvdelivery_flg' WHERE bo.customer_id = #{customerId} AND bo.farmer_id = #{farmerId}
ORDER BY bo.order_time desc, bo.order_id, bodi.item_name
